name: io.github.gnasdev/gn-tracing
title: GN Tracing
description: Read a GN Tracing browser recording from a replay link: console errors with source-mapped stacks, failed network requests, WebSocket activity, and the user-event timeline, so an agent can trace a bug back to a file and line in the codebase.

packageArguments.name: --allow-dir
packageArguments.description: Directory that downloaded recording .zip packages may be read from. Repeatable. Local file reading is disabled unless this is given; hosted replay links need no arguments.
